messages.en_US: Do you want to sail somewhere?

en_US: Aye, aye!
Anchors aweigh!
You just go on and tell me whenever
you want to set sail again!
...You are?
OK, you’re {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
I’m Riley. I’m a Trainer, as well.
I also came to Iron Island to train.
Anyway, it’s always nice to meet
another Trainer.
If it’s all right with you, I’d like to
challenge you to a battle right now.
Riley: Thank you. I can sense you have
a strong aura.
Backed up by strong Pokémon, no less!
Allow me to heal your Pokémon...
Riley: I’ll be training more inside.
You can join me if you’d like.
I’m the Steel-type Master!
I aim to find the ultimate Steel-type!
Come at me with only a {COLOR 1}single Pokémon{COLOR 0}
in your party if you want to battle me.
Oh, and there’s one other condition...
That Pokémon must be a {COLOR 1}Steel-type{COLOR 0}!
Your Steel-type looks pretty strong!
Should we find out who has the
ultimate Steel-type Pokémon?
Time for a Steel-type battle!
Oh, wow.
It seems the ultimate Steel-type
Pokémon belongs to you!
That means you are the rightful owner
of this precious item!
The ultimate Steel-type Pokémon
belongs to me!
But I’m always ready for another
Steel-type battle.
Thank you for a great Steel-type
Pokémon battle.
Hmm...
Do you feel like you can’t win?
